highlight.title: Agatha Christie's Tommy & Tuppence
highlight.description: Antonia Thomas and Josh Dylan star as Christie's amateur sleuthing duo in this contemporary reimagining, with Imelda Staunton as Tommy's formidable Aunt Ada. Two episodes premiere September 15 on Christie's own birthday, with one new episode weekly after that.

new_arrivals.title: Cooper and Fry
new_arrivals.badge: New to BritBox · North America Premiere
new_arrivals.description: Robert James-Collier and Mandip Gill star as DC Ben Cooper and DC Diane Fry, a Peak District detective pairing of local roots and city reserve, tackling murders across the fictional town of Edendale.

new_arrivals.title: Showtrial
new_arrivals.description: A courtroom drama following high-profile criminal cases from arrest through trial, with each season built around a new case and cast. Season 1 centres on Talitha Campbell, accused of conspiring to murder a fellow student.

new_arrivals.title: Monarch of the Glen
new_arrivals.description: Alastair Mackenzie stars as Archie MacDonald, who returns home to the Scottish Highlands and finds himself responsible for his family's financially troubled estate. A beloved classic, back for the first time in years.

originals.title: Happy Valley
originals.description: Sarah Lancashire won a BAFTA for her portrayal of West Yorkshire police sergeant Catherine Cawood, among other honours. Intense, perfectly written, and utterly unmissable.

originals.title: Trigger Point
originals.description: Vicky McClure is magnetic as explosives officer Lana Washington. Each series is a taut, gripping thriller with real stakes and superb performances.

originals.title: Beyond Paradise
originals.description: A warm, character-driven spin-off of Death in Paradise, following Kris Marshall's Humphrey Goodman as he settles into life in Devon and Cornwall.

originals.title: The Other Bennet Sister
originals.description: A new drama inspired by the world of Jane Austen, focusing on Mary Bennet, the overlooked middle sister of Pride and Prejudice, as she forges her own path.
